text: {"observations":"E:9(*1)/3 is an E9 chord with the root omitted and the third in the bass, so the expected pitch classes are G#, B, D and F#, with G# strongest. Chroma for 4.8-7.2 s shows G#100, F#48, D18 (in the 4.8-6.0 s step: G#100, F#39, D18, B7), which fits option B. The other windows do not fit: 0-4.8 s is A/G#/D#/G, 7.2-9.6 s is A/G#/D#/G, and 9.6-10.8 s is A#/G# with no D or F#, ruling out A, C and D.","answer":"B"}
